home.heroSubtitle: Challenge your football intellect across 13 unique game modes. Play solo, pass-and-play with friends, or battle in real-time online multiplayer rooms!

career_path.title: Career Path Challenge
career_path.desc: Guess the superstar from their chronological club transfers. Hints cost points!

football_auction.title: Football Auction
football_auction.desc: Name as many valid answers as you can before the countdown runs out.

historic_lineup.title: Historic Match Lineup
historic_lineup.desc: Identify the hidden starters on the interactive pitch of legendary finals.

password_link.title: Password / Common Link
password_link.desc: Uncover the secret link connecting three famous footballers or managers.

lightning_round.title: Lightning Round (30s)
lightning_round.desc: Fire through rapid questions in 30 seconds with streak multipliers!

guess_match.title: Guess the Match
guess_match.desc: Deduce the iconic match from the final score, scorers, and goal minutes.

numbers_stats.title: Numbers & Stats
numbers_stats.desc: Records, appearances, fastest goals, and Higher/Lower showdowns.

nicknames_terms.title: Nicknames & Terms
nicknames_terms.desc: Famous club nicknames, tactical jargon, trophies, and football folklore.

referee_laws.title: Referee Laws & Scenarios
referee_laws.desc: IFAB rules, tricky offsides, penalties, and referee masterclasses.

continental_tournaments.title: World Cup & Continental
continental_tournaments.desc: World Cup, UCL, AFCON, AFC Asian Cup, and Arab Cup glory.

joker_double.title: Joker Double Points
joker_double.desc: Activate your ONE joker card before the question to double your points!

tiered_risk.title: Tiered Risk System
tiered_risk.desc: Pick Easy (+100), Medium (+200, -50), or Hard (+350, -150 penalty)!

steal_round.title: Steal Round
steal_round.desc: Wrong answer gives rivals a dramatic 5-second window to steal points!

about.title: About Koora Plus
about.intro: Koora Plus is a modern, 100% free-to-play football quiz web app engineered for true football enthusiasts across the Arab world and globally.
about.f1: 13 authentic game modes including Career Path, Football Auction, Historic Lineups, and IFAB Referee Laws.
about.f2: Real-time online multiplayer over the internet with room codes and live scoreboard sync.
about.f3: Full bilingual support in Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR).
about.f4: Zero paywalls, zero account logins, 100% free-tier architecture.
about.f5: Offline solo play via Progressive Web App (PWA) installation.
about.copyright: Made with passion for football fans.
